name: Cheapest 20% / priciest 20%
desc: Long the day’s 20% lowest-forecast intervals, short the 20% highest.

name: 20% / 20% · 2× in the extreme 5%
desc: Same trades, but the day’s cheapest and priciest 5% get double size.

name: 20% / 20% · scaled up to 3×
desc: Size grows linearly from 1× at the 20% line to 3× at the day’s extreme.

name: Extremes only · 10% / 10%
desc: Trade only the day’s most extreme forecast prices.

name: Wide-spread days only
desc: Cheapest/priciest 20%, but only on days whose forecast spread exceeds 600 DKK.

name: Daily z-score reversion
desc: Long when the forecast is 1σ below its daily mean, short 1σ above.

name: Residual demand
desc: Long when demand minus wind and solar is tight, short when it is loose.

name: Wind fade
desc: Long on calm intervals (wind < 700 MW), short when wind > 2,300 MW.

name: Power vs gas
desc: Long when power is cheap relative to yesterday’s gas price, short when rich.

name: Below the hourly baseline
desc: Long when the transfer model’s 15-min forecast sits under the hourly baseline, short when well above.

name: Forecast momentum
desc: Follow the forecast’s 1-hour move: long if up > 65 DKK, short if down > 65.
